body.objective: Assemble the five generic parity-even third-curvature repository form-factor functions from the certified physical, ghost, contact and Schur carriers, or identify the first exact missing analytic datum.
body.stop_condition: Pin by hash the certified five-carrier scalar-flat manifest and functional relation, the eleven physical H1-cubed channels, six-master coordinates, relative-IBP boundary fluxes, H1-H2 contact endpoints, full-BV multiplicity ledger and normalized longitudinal Schur trace-log data.  In one declared Mellin/proper-time scheme, project every complete one-loop physical and ghost contribution onto the five repository carriers and derive the five labelled-box form-factor functions, including source-permutation covariance, scale derivatives, branch/regularity domains and the certified functional relation.  Separate additive local C^2 and dressed R^2 normalization constants from the nonlocal functions.  Recover the round-S4 and S2xS2 special-background rows and all equal-box/flat-TT limits as holdouts.  If the available primed Green or reference-scale data do not determine all five functions, compute the maximal exact combinations that are determined and export the first missing kernel/spectral datum with a receiver contract.  Use a method-distinct reconstruction or differential-equation verifier and reject one channel-sign, contact, scale and zero-mode mutation.
body.current_gate: five generic parity-even third-curvature form factors or the maximal determined quotient plus exact missing datum
body.forbid: no special-background finite determinant interpolated into a generic form factor; no physical-only rows called full BV; no contact or relative-IBP boundary term omitted; no local normalization ambiguity folded into a nonlocal coefficient; no parity-odd, QME, Lorentzian, state, particle, scattering or unitarity promotion
activates: a complete parity-even one-loop third-curvature effective-action table
or a precise generic spectral/Green-kernel producer request
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM INDEPENDENT COEFFICIENT LANE.  Use the already certified even carrier and master infrastructure; do not wait for the parity-odd syzygy engine or a compensator action.
notes: The carrier dimension and many master rows are certified, but the five repository functions and coefficients remain explicitly open.
A maximal determined quotient with one exact missing analytic input is a valid terminal result.
